estilo: Painted fantasy RPG item illustration, matching a hand-painted tabletop card: realistic digital oil painting with fine, visible brushwork and rich material rendering (thick hand-blown glass with small imperfections and bubbles, cork, dripping sealing wax, twine, aged brass, leather). Exactly ONE object, shown in three-quarter view from slightly above (about 30 degrees), tilted a little on a diagonal, centered in a square frame and filling about 70% of it, with even empty margins on all four sides; no part of the object touches or is cut by the image edges. Lighting: warm, soft key light from the upper left, a subtle cool rim light on the right edge, gentle specular highlights on the glass; the liquid may glow softly from within, but every effect (glow, smoke, mist, sparks) stays inside the vessel or touching it: no aura, halo, light bloom or rays around the object. Palette: warm earthy neutrals (umber, sepia, ochre, cork brown, aged brass) with a single saturated accent color that comes from the vessel's contents. Vessel families, keep them consistent across the series: a drinkable POTION is a round-bottomed glass flask with a long neck, cork stopper sealed with red-brown wax and wrapped with twine; an OIL is a small squat flat-sided glass vial with a wide cork and a thick drip of the liquid running down its side; a GRENADE is a throwable spherical glass orb held in a few thin hammered-iron bands, with a short wax-sealed spout capped by a small solid iron knob. Background: perfectly flat, uniform, pure white (#FFFFFF) from edge to edge, with no texture, gradient, vignette, surface, horizon or reflection. The object floats on the white: no cast shadow and no contact shadow on the background.
evitar: text, letters, words, numbers, runes, glyphs that look like writing, labels or tags with writing, logos, watermark, signature; frame, border, card layout, UI, parchment texture; hands, people, faces, skulls, creatures; scenery, table, cloth, shelf, any surface or horizon; colored, gradient or textured background, vignette, cast shadow, drop shadow, reflection on the ground; more than one vessel, duplicates, extra props, coins; hanging loops, open rings or handles with background showing through them; glow halo, aura, light bloom or rays around the object, sparks or smoke floating detached from the vessel; object cropped or touching the image edges; photographic studio product shot, glossy 3D render or plastic look, cartoon, flat vector, anime, neon colors

estilos.arma: Painted fantasy RPG item illustration, matching a hand-painted tabletop card: realistic digital oil painting with fine, visible brushwork and rich, believable materials (forged steel with fine scratches and a soft satin sheen, worn wood grain, wrapped and stitched leather, aged brass and iron fittings). A mundane, well-made, practical medieval-fantasy weapon: not magical, no glow, no gems, no runes or etched writing. Exactly ONE weapon, complete from end to end and never cropped, laid on a diagonal like an item in an adventurer's catalog: grip or handle toward the upper right, the striking end (blade tip, axe head, spear point, muzzle) toward the lower left, seen from slightly above (about 30 degrees). Long weapons (polearms, spears, bows, two-handed swords, muskets) run corner to corner on a steep diagonal so they stay as large as possible; compact weapons fill about 70% of the square. Even empty margins on all four sides; nothing touches the image edges. Lighting: warm, soft key light from the upper left, a subtle cool rim light on the right edge, crisp specular glints along steel edges. Palette: warm earthy neutrals (umber, sepia, ochre, leather brown, aged brass) with cool silver-grey steel as the accent. Background: perfectly flat, uniform, pure white (#FFFFFF) from edge to edge, no texture, gradient, vignette, surface, horizon or reflection. The weapon floats on the white: no cast shadow and no contact shadow.
estilos.municao: Painted fantasy RPG item illustration, matching a hand-painted tabletop card: realistic digital oil painting with fine, visible brushwork and rich materials (stitched leather, worn wood, dull lead, iron, feathers). A small still life of ammunition: ONE container (pouch, bag or quiver) with a few pieces of its ammunition showing or spilled just in front of it, all touching or overlapping into one compact group, seen in three-quarter view from slightly above (about 30 degrees), centered and filling about 70% of the square, even empty margins, nothing touching the image edges. Straps and drawstrings lie flat against the container, never hanging in open loops. Lighting: warm, soft key light from the upper left, subtle cool rim light on the right. Palette: warm earthy neutrals with a dull metal accent. Background: perfectly flat, uniform, pure white (#FFFFFF) from edge to edge, no texture, gradient, vignette, surface or reflection. The group floats on the white: no cast shadow and no contact shadow.
estilos.armadura: Painted fantasy RPG item illustration, matching a hand-painted tabletop card: realistic digital oil painting with fine, visible brushwork and rich, believable materials (forged steel plates with rivets and a soft satin sheen, mail, boiled and stitched leather, quilted cloth, fur, buckles and straps). Body armor is shown upright as if worn by an invisible person: hollow, no body, no head, no mannequin, no stand, the dark inside visible at the neck and arm openings; three-quarter front view, the torso piece from shoulders to hips, centered and filling about 70% of the square. Shields are shown alone, front face toward the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle, the arm straps hidden behind. Mundane, well-made and practical: no glow, no gems, no runes, no heraldry, no lettering. Light-colored materials are warm (oatmeal, tan, honey), never white or near-white. Even empty margins on all four sides; nothing touches the image edges. Lighting: warm, soft key light from the upper left, a subtle cool rim light on the right edge. Palette: warm earthy neutrals (umber, sepia, ochre, leather brown, aged brass) with cool steel as the accent. Background: perfectly flat, uniform, pure white (#FFFFFF) from edge to edge, no texture, gradient, vignette, surface or reflection. The piece floats on the white: no cast shadow and no contact shadow.

_notas_armas_armaduras: estilos[tipo] e evitar_por_tipo[tipo] SUBSTITUEM estilo/evitar (não somam): as listas gerais são das poções ('more than one vessel', 'extra props') e brigariam com munição. Para itens sem tipo listado, use estilo/evitar das poções. Orientação comum às armas: empunhadura para cima/direita, ponta ou parte que golpeia para baixo/esquerda, como a Adaga de referência.

itens.curar-ferimentos-i: a POTION flask filled with rich ruby-red liquid glowing warmly from within, a few tiny golden sparks of light rising through it

itens.escuridao: an OIL vial filled with inky, light-absorbing black liquid, its highlights swallowed by the darkness, thin wisps of dark charcoal-grey smoke curling out from under the cork
itens.luz: an OIL vial filled with radiant warm amber liquid glowing brightly from within like a captured candle flame, the glass lit gold from inside
itens.nevoa: a GRENADE orb packed with dense, slowly swirling mid-grey mist that stays sealed inside the glass
itens.primor-atletico: a POTION flask filled with vivid sunset-orange liquid full of lively rising bubbles, a small green laurel leaf tied to its neck with twine
itens.protecao-divina: a POTION flask filled with pearly white, softly luminous liquid, a small round silver medallion with a plain sunburst design tied flat against its neck
itens.resistencia-a-energia: a POTION flask whose liquid settles in three distinct horizontal layers, fiery red-orange at the bottom, icy pale blue in the middle and crackling electric yellow on top
itens.sono: a POTION flask filled with midnight-indigo liquid with tiny silver motes drifting like stars, a small sprig of dried lavender tied to its neck with twine
itens.suporte-ambiental: a sturdy POTION flask with a thin leather strap wrapped snugly around its neck, filled with clear turquoise liquid holding a single suspended air bubble and one small green leaf
itens.tranca-arcana: an OIL vial filled with heavy, slow dark-bronze liquid with a dull metallic sheen, a small old iron key with a solid round bow, tied flat against its neck with cord
itens.visao-mistica: a POTION flask filled with luminous emerald-green liquid, a slow spiral swirl at its center catching sparkling glints of light
itens.vitalidade-fantasma: a POTION flask filled with an almost colorless, spectral pale liquid, the glass itself slightly frosted and misty, faint ghostly white wisps rising and fading inside it; a thin, clearly defined smoky-grey rim outlines every glass edge

itens.alabarda: a halberd: a tall ash-wood shaft with an iron-shod butt, topped by a steel head combining a broad axe blade, a rear hooked spike and a straight top spear point; full length on a steep diagonal
itens.alfange: a large broad scimitar (falchion-like): a wide, heavily curved single-edged steel blade that broadens toward the tip, a simple brass cross-guard and a leather-wrapped grip, desert-made
itens.arco-curto: a short hunting bow of plain honey-brown wood with a leather-wrapped grip and horn-tipped ends, strung with a thin taut bowstring; no arrow
itens.arco-longo: a war longbow as tall as a person, of honey-colored yew with darker heartwood, a leather grip wrap and horn nocks, strung with a thin taut bowstring; full length corner to corner on a steep diagonal; no arrow
itens.azagaia: a light throwing javelin: a slim flexible wooden shaft with a small leaf-shaped iron head and a short leather grip binding at its balance point; full length on a steep diagonal
itens.besta-leve: a light crossbow seen in three-quarter view from above: a plain wooden stock with a simple iron trigger, a short wood-and-steel prod with its string drawn back and cocked; no bolt loaded
itens.besta-pesada: a heavy crossbow seen in three-quarter view from above: a massive dark wooden stock reinforced with iron bands, a thick steel prod with its heavy string drawn back and cocked, an iron cocking lever lying along the stock; no bolt loaded
itens.bordao: a quarterstaff: a long, straight staff of dark seasoned oak, both ends capped with iron ferrules and a worn leather grip in the middle; full length corner to corner on a steep diagonal

itens.cimitarra: a scimitar: a slender, strongly curved single-edged steel blade, a simple cross-guard with downturned quillons and a leather-wrapped grip
